rationale.conceptual: DFT with PBE+vdW for surface chemistry is a well-established methodology; however, correctly setting up pseudopotentials, k-points, slab model, adsorption site screening, and extracting work functions requires careful implementation and domain knowledge.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves at least seven separate geometry optimizations (pristine slab, three molecules on pristine, one O2 pre-adsorption, two on O2-covered) plus band structure and work function calculations. Each requires trying multiple sites/orientations, leading to many DFT jobs. Orchestrating this with scripted Quantum ESPRESSO or similar, handling convergence and I/O, is substantial engineering.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT study, but the reproduction requires a multi-step pipeline of geometry optimizations for several adsorption configurations, plus electronic property extraction. Method is conceptually moderate; execution is heavy due to many DFT runs.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small supercell of 50 atoms, modest plane-wave cutoff (400 eV), CPU-only typical of such DFT calculations. Memory is a few GB per job; no external dataset.
